arguments.title: INC-2023-04-18-001
arguments.body: Incident index — April 18, 2023 (sev2). A shard-keeper config push changed a label name, but rollup-service did not pick up the matching change. This producer-consumer mismatch impaired ingestion for approximately 5 hours 45 minutes; symptom alerts fired while cause alerts did not. No data loss was reported. During response, the rollback path proved fragile once state had partially moved. For similar incidents, verify emitted labels against downstream consumer expectations and use the tested rollback procedure; do not assume a partially applied rollback is reversible.
